headline: AMBER: Monza 1:36:30 (4:34/km, negative split). Left knee pain on the post-race jog, Tue run gated on a knee test
summary: Race: 21.18km in 1:36:30, avg HR 167, icu 136 (plan 170, icu undercounts sustained threshold). Km 0-5 at 4:36-4:46 (HR 151-162), km 5-16 at 4:33-4:39 (HR 162-169), km 17-21 at 4:11-4:32 (HR 172-187). 3:30 under the 1:40 ceiling, pacing exactly as prescribed. Post-race jog: 5.7km, 43min moving inside 99min elapsed, with a 50min stop at km 2.5. The last 30min ran at 7:30-8:30/km and 153-159 spm (race: 166-169 spm), cold after the stop on fatigued quads. That slow, low-cadence shuffle is the classic trigger for both lateral ITB and patellofemoral pain. New side: the Aug flare was right knee. Wellness: HRV 55 (7-day avg 62, down from 70), RHR 49, sleep 5.7h. CTL 49.8, ATL 59.5, TSB -10.
flags: Knee test tonight and Tue morning: locate it (lateral, 2-3cm above the joint line = ITB; around or under the kneecap = patellofemoral), 10 single-leg squats left, 2 flights of stairs down, Noble compression. Any pain = Tue becomes 50min bike 120-135bpm.
Mon rest: walk 30min, foam roll lateral thigh and quads 10min. No running to test it.
If pain appears during Tue's run: stop and walk back. No running through it, that is how March started.
Race HR says LTHR is likely ~170, not 165 (moderate confidence). Zones are understating; re-check LTHR after Wk4. VWT 2h00 target looks conservative, revisit in Wk5.
HRV 54-57 four mornings running with Bucharest travel: Wk4 recovery is in the right place.
Push opportunity (+10%): if knee clean Tue-Thu and HRV back over 62, Sat long goes 2h15 to 2h30 (load 110 to 120).
Wk3 actual 359 vs 455 planned: Wed and Sat shakeouts skipped, no impact on fitness.
suggestedChange: Tue/Wed stop rules now carry the left-knee gate (pushed). Sat long +15min to 2h30 / load 120 only if the knee is clean Tue-Thu; confirm Thu evening.
